title: Silver / hybrid STT routing audit log row v1
description: One append-only audit row for local vs vendor STT routing, latency, and errors. Contract only: no COGS amounts or vendor quotes. Aligns with docs/research/silver_tech_cogs_unit_economics_template_v1.md (table is informative; this schema is normative). B-track / research until product wiring exists.

event_id.description: Idempotent row id for dedup and trace.

occurred_at_utc.description: Event clock (client or server receipt), ISO-8601 with Z preferred.

session_id.description: Opaque session or device bucket id; no raw PII in this field.

route.description: rejected = gated before vendor call (e.g. low confidence).

provider.description: Vendor id when route=vendor (e.g. gcp_speech_v2); null for local/rejected.

audio_duration_ms.description: Input audio length for normalization and COGS rollups (no pricing here).

latency_ms.description: Round-trip latency for vendor path; null if local or rejected before vendor.

error_code.description: Stable machine code when failed; null or omit when success.

chars_out.description: Transcript length hint for downstream caps (optional at emit time).

billing_unit.description: Optional invoice key hint (e.g. per_minute); no amounts in this row.

pii_redaction.description: Redaction posture applied to this log row.
